name: Honda CB650
engine: 627 cc air-cooled SOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: The last of Honda's single-cam fours. A good runner once the carbs and charging system are sorted.

G: Rebuild and sync the four carbs as one set. Mixing jets between carbs is the usual cause of uneven running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
